B0FQC6VCDW.title: ULTRALOQ Bolt SE Wifi Smart Deadbolt Lock, Supports Matter, Remote Control
bullets: 7 in 1 Keyless Entry Door Lock: Fingerprint ID(stores up to 50 fingerprints) + Passcodes(up to 50) + Smartphone App(compatible with Android and iOS) + Web Portal + EKey / Code Sharing + Voice Control with Siri, Alexa or Google Assistant + 2 Mechanical Keys

App Control via Built-in WiFi: Remotely lock, unlock, and manage your smart lock from anywhere. Share permanent, scheduled, or temporary eKeys and passcodes with family, guests, or service providers. Manage up to 50 fingerprints and 50 access codes, view activity history, and receive real-time notifications—all without a hub. Supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only. For optimal connectivity, keep your router within 70 ft of the lock.

Remote Access via Matter over Thread: Remotely lock, unlock, and manage your smart lock through Apple Home or other Matter-compatible apps. Enjoy simple setup, real-time notifications, event history, and secure access management—all from your smartphone. Requires a compatible Matter over Thread hub (Thread Border Router).

Effortless Matter Smart Home Integration: Ultraloq matter smart lock seamlessly integrates with all matter-enabled ecosystems. Voice control with Siri, Alexa and Google Assistant. It can be used to automate your smart home by pairing multiple matter-enabled devices through the one app. No more compatibility headaches. Requires a compatible Matter over Thread hub (Thread Border Router).

Reliable Connection: Enjoy fast, stable, and responsive communication with Matter over Thread. The self-healing mesh network automatically reroutes connections if a device becomes unavailable, helping keep your smart home connected with minimal interruptions. Requires a compatible Matter over Thread hub (Thread Border Router).

Ultra-long 18 Months Battery Life: Thread’s low-energy mesh network helps extend battery life up to 18 months, so you change batteries less often. Enjoy a smarter, greener, and more sustainable way to secure your home without sacrificing speed or stability.

Auto Lock: Set a preset timer for auto-lock, or press the “ULTRALOQ” button to lock instantly. Stay informed with real-time low battery alerts so you're never caught off guard. Door sensor not included

ANSI BHMA Certified & Easy DIY Installation: Built to last with zinc alloy materials and a weather-resistant design (suitable for exterior home doors, IP65 Waterproof), ensuring reliable performance in any climate. Install the smart deadbolt lock in 10 minutes with simple step-by-step instructions, no professional help need

Timely Customer Service: Lifetime mechanical coverage, 18-month electronic protection, plus lifetime phone support (Mon–Fri, 7 AM–6 PM PST) and 24/7 after-sales email service. Questions or need assistance? Feel free to contact us anytime.

B0CZNZGGS7.title: Aqara Smart Lock U50, Apple Home Key, Keyless Entry Deadbolt, Black
bullets: 【Apple Home and Home Key Support】The U50 is a smart door lock that is fully integrated into Apple Home. It can be unlocked with the Apple Home Key by simply tapping an iPhone or Apple Watch, even when the iPhone or Apple Watch is out of power. Moreover, you can manage and share door access for your guests in Apple Home. With a Matter compatible Aqara hub, it features Matter support.(Tips: After adding the door lock to the Aqara Home app, only the administrator's fingerprint or password can reset the door lock.)

【Remote Passwords and Unlock】The Smart Lock U50 offers multiple ways to unlock, including keypad unlocking, remotely configurable passwords via the Aqara Home app (An Aqara Zigbee 3.0 hub is required), one-time local passwords when no internet connection is available, and a temporary password for visitors. * The NFC card is not included and is sold separately.

【Automations with Aqara and Third-Party Devices】With an Aqara Zigbee 3.0 hub, the smart door lock U50 is compatible with third-party ecosystems like Google Home, Alexa and IFTTT, allowing it to be easily integrated into a wide range of smart home setups and used in smart home automations. For example, when someone presses the Aqara Video Doorbell G4, you will be able to view who is at your door and easily unlock the U50 door lock. (Zigbee2MQTT and comparable third-party USB dongles are not officially supported by Aqara. Full product functionality may be limited or unavailable.)

【Auto Lock & Do Not Disturb Mode】Thanks to the built-in gyroscope, the auto-lock feature locks the door for you after you close it. Alternatively, you can disable this feature and leave the door in the passage mode. Also, the Do Not Disturb mode can mute the door lock sounds within a certain period of time, to avoid affecting your family’s sleep when you get back home late.

【A Durable and Secure Deadbolt Lock with Long Battery Life】 The U50 is powered by 4 AA Batteries (6V batteries required, included) and has a long battery life of up to 6 months. Also, a USB-C to A port for emergency charging is available. The lock body made of zinc alloy has an IPX5 rating and complies with the same safety standard as BHMA Level 3. It’s capable of withstanding temperatures ranging from -31°F to 150.8°F. Your sensitive data is stored locally and fully AES encrypted.

【Rekeying Made Easy with U50】The Smart Lock U50 cylinder is designed for rekeying. Simply remove the lock cylinder, have a locksmith adjust the pins to match your existing 5-pin key, and you'll be able to continue using your original key to unlock it.

B0FRS6T6HL.title: Aqara UWB Smart Lock U400, Apple Home Key, Fingerprint Deadbolt, Black
bullets: True Hands-Free Unlocking with UWB Technology: Experience a new era of smart access — UWB (Ultra-Wideband) detects your incoming presence, direction, and intent to unlock automatically as you approach. It provides a faster, more convenient, and highly secure way to enter your home without touching the lock. Perfect when your hands are full, you're wearing gloves, or arriving in the rain. (Note: UWB unlocking requires a Thread-enabled Apple Home hub and is supported on Apple Watch Series 6 or later (excluding SE) running watchOS 11.5+ and iPhone 11 or later (excluding iPhone SE & iPhone 16e) running iOS 18.5+.)

All-in-One Unlocking Options: Enjoy Apple home key tap-to-unlock (requires an Apple Thread-enabled Matter controller: HomePod 2nd Gen, HomePod mini, or Apple TV 4K 2021/2022), plus fingerprint, touchscreen passcode, voice assistant control, app remote access, NFC card support (card sold separately), and a physical key, giving you flexible, reliable ways to enter your home in any situation.

Matter Over Thread for Multi-Ecosystem Compatibility: Built with Matter over Thread, the U400 can connect to multiple smart home platforms simultaneously, allowing you to enjoy the unique features of each ecosystem. Thread offers faster response, more stable connectivity, lower power consumption, and secure data transmission. Note: A Thread-enabled Matter controller from each ecosystem is required for its respective platform.

Convenient Rechargeable Power System: Powered by a rechargeable and removable lithium battery that lasts up to 6 months per charge. Use the lock's USB-C port to recharge without taking the lock offline, or remove the battery and charge it separately. A low-battery voice alert will notify you when the battery drops below 20%, ensuring you never get caught off guard.

Certified Security & Outdoor Durability: BHMA-certified for proven protection, mechanical strength, and long-term reliability. The IP65-rated exterior guards against dust and water for dependable outdoor performance. Plus, the rekeyable design allows you to change the physical key without replacing the entire lock cylinder.

Unlock More Features with the Aqara App: Customize your security with Auto Lock, Night Latch Mode (only admins and physical keys can unlock at night), and Do Not Disturb Mode. Integrates seamlessly with Aqara cameras like the G5 Pro and G410 doorbell, allowing you to view visitors and unlock directly via live video interaction.

specs.Special Feature: UWB True Hands-Free Unlock (requires a Thread-enabled Apple Home hub)

B0F8RC3YRF.title: Level Bolt Smart Deadbolt - Make Your Lock Smart, Keep Your Keys & Hardware
bullets: TURN YOUR EXISTING LOCK INTO A SMART LOCK: Level Bolt replaces the deadbolt in your door to turn your lock into a smart lock without changing keys, hardware, or the look of your door.

SEAMLESS INTEROPERABILITY WITH MATTER: Easily integrate with up to 3 smart home platforms at the same time including Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and compatible with Samsung SmartThings. Lock/unlock with simple voice commands (e.g., “Alexa, unlock front door”) or create smart home automations with voice assistants running on Matter-over-Thread.
LOCK & UNLOCK FROM ANYWHERE: Matter-over-Thread enabled remote access to remotely lock or unlock your door from anywhere using smart home apps (requires Matter-over-Thread Hub + Border Router).

KEYLESS ENTRY VIA LEVEL HOME APP: Lock and unlock your door with the Level Home app (available for iOS & Android). Share keyless access with people you trust, view activity history, and always know the status of your lock via the Level Home app.
SAFE AND SECURE: Featuring a 6-stage stainless steel gearbox, Level Bolt exceeds the highest industry standards for strength and security, keeping you and your home safe.

FITS MOST EXTERIOR DOORS: Level Bolt is designed for the majority of American standard exterior doors, allowing you to keep your lock and keys unchanged. Check the Product Guides and Documents section to confirm that your existing deadbolt is compatible.

DIY INSTALLATION: Fits most American standard doors (1.75" thick). Replace the inner deadbolt hardware with just a single screwdriver, no drilling or hardwiring. Includes DIY install guide plus access to how-to video library and expert support 7 days/week.

B0BCGH7D8H.title: Yale Smart Lock Deadbolt with Google Matter, Keyless Entry, Matte Black
bullets: MORE WAYS TO ENTER: Hands full of groceries? This keyless entry door lock unlocks with a tap on your phone, a code on the keypad, Google Assistant voice commands, plus a backup key if all else fails.

COMPLETE CONTROL: This electronic door lock puts home security in your pocket. Lock up, share access, and track entries via Yale Access App or Google Home (US & Canada only). Remote access available with a Matter hub.
DESIGNED FOR GOOGLE HOME: This smart front door lock integrates seamlessly into Google Home systems. Control access and monitor activity using the setup you already trust.

SMART HOME FREEDOM WITH MATTER: Built with Matter technology, this lock connects to your favorite devices, including Google TV, Nest Hub, and more. Mix and match without being locked into one ecosystem.

LONG-LASTING BATTERY: Matter over Thread technology uses an energy-efficient mesh network that minimizes power drain so your smart door lock goes longer between battery changes. Grade 2 certified by BHMA & designed to perform from -22 - 140°F.

B0GX14GPT3.title: TCL Smart Lock, Palm Vein Keyless Entry Deadbolt with Matter Over Thread
bullets: ADVANCED PALM VEIN UNLOCKING: Enjoy effortless, touch-free unlocking when your hands are full with groceries, packages, or everyday essentials. Powered by advanced palm vein recognition technology, this keyless entry door lock identifies unique vein patterns beneath the skin for fast 0.3-second recognition, delivering reliable access for everyone from growing children to seniors, even with wet hands or rough skin. Biometric data is encrypted and stored locally on the device, never uploaded to the cloud, protecting your privacy.

SMART HOME INTEGRATION WITH MATTER OVER THREAD: Effortlessly manage your front door access from anywhere, whether at work, traveling, or relaxing at home. Featuring Matter over Thread connectivity and built-in Wi-Fi, this smart deadbolt lock works natively with Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home, and SmartThings, connecting with compatible devices to create personalized routines. Set up automations like turning on lights when you unlock your door. Share temporary digital keys with trusted guests or renters, monitor access activity, and enjoy reliable low-power connectivity powered by Thread’s mesh network, even when Wi-Fi goes off.

UP TO 8 MONTHS OF BATTERY LIFE – Powered by 8 AA batteries, this smart door lock provides up to 8 months of everyday use based on TCL laboratory testing. Low-battery notifications are sent to your phone, and local alerts help remind you when it is time to replace the batteries, so you can stay ahead of unexpected power loss.

BHMA-CERTIFIED SECURITY & ALL-WEATHER DURABILITY – The fingerprint door lock is built to meet rigorous BHMA standards for strength and durability. The integrated smart doorbell provides a local chime and visitor alerts on your phone, while the aluminum alloy construction and IP55 weather-resistant design help protect against everyday outdoor conditions from -13°F to 158°F.

EASY DIY INSTALLATION FOR FRONT DOORS – Install your smart lock with a standard Phillips screwdriver—no hardwiring, professional installation, or extra drilling required. Designed for standard residential doors with a single lock hole and ideal for front doors, side entrances, garage entryways, and rental properties.
